about.title: About this blog
about.body:
A.I Kwa Kila Siku (“AI every day”) is a bilingual blog that explains Artificial Intelligence in plain language, with real East African examples.

You will find explanations of A.I concepts, real projects being built, new tools and tech news — a new post twice a week.

Author: Davy Swai, a developer and A.I specialist from Dar es Salaam and founder of Odessa Lab Technologies.
